Maria (CSM): Quick flag — ClearParrot onboarding: noticed repeated tail spikes on chat completions. 95th ~1.2s this week, some p99 blips. Renewal check in ~6w; want to get ahead so we don't escalate risk. Recommend a focused mitigation: staggered int8 quant canary + selective model swap to a compact variant + split routing for high-priority vs low-priority flows. Need Eng + SRE help to run small canary and ops runbook. @Devin @Lloyd @Clara :eyes:

Devin (Eng): Sounds good. I can run a staggered canary and a controlled model swap. Proposal: 1) 5% int8 on short requests (<512 tokens) 2) 10% model-swap to compact-v2 on low-priority routes 3) enable prefix KV caching on those canary routes. Will monitor latency/quality.

Devin (Eng): Canary commands I'll use:
```bash
# canary deploy (example)
rwd deploy canary --customer clearparrot --model compact-v2-int8 --pct 5 --routes "short_chat"
rwd model route-update --customer clearparrot --selector "priority:low" --model compact-v2 --pct 10
# routing policy
rwd router update --customer clearparrot --policy split --primary dedicated --fallback hosted --selector "priority:low"
```

Lloyd (SRE): Add to watchlist: p50/p95/p99 latency, error rate, token-usage delta, and any spike in model timeouts. Also capture sample outputs to run the eval set for quality drift. If p95 improves and quality within thresholds, scale rollout to 25% then 50%. Set fail-open to current model if error rate >0.5% for 5m. :white_check_mark:

Clara (SolutionsEng): I'll draft a customer-facing note explaining expected behavior and the small canary. Also will prepare an enablement runbook for CS + support: steps to roll back, how to interpret metrics, and a short playbook for common regressions. Can do an enablement call next Tue 10:00 PT — want to invite ClearParrot PM + infra.

Eva (Product): From product side please set explicit rollback thresholds:
- latency p95 target: <=800ms post-canary
- quality drift: no more than 3% increase in token-level edit distance on our calibration prompts
If thresholds breached, auto-rollback to baseline model. Also recommend we try the compact-v2 int8 profile first (fewer quant steps) before more aggressive quant.

Devin (Eng): Will implement rollout gates: time-based + metric-based. Plan: 5% -> 15% -> 40% over 24h with manual check at each stage. I will tag deploys with `cs_clearparrot_canary_1715432100`.

deploy-bot: Canary job started for clearparrot by Devin. job_id=canary-cc-1715432100, started_at=1715432120 UTC.

Lloyd (SRE): Also adding a temporary routing rule to prioritize dedicated capacity for `priority:high` requests, everything else falls back to split policy. I'll patch routing now and watch for imbalance.

Maria (CSM): Thanks everyone. Action owners: Devin = canary + model swap exec, Lloyd = routing + monitoring dashboards, Clara = customer note + runbook + enablement session invite, Eva = threshold approvals. I'll loop in renewal AE if we see positive trend; if negative, we'll prep a tiered credit/comp plan. I'll update the ticket with these owners and ETA for initial results 24h after canary start. :slightly_smiling_face:

Clara (SolutionsEng): Quick note for customer comms — be explicit that this is a limited canary for specific routes and that we can roll back immediately. I'll include the sample command we ran and a short FAQ.

Devin (Eng): Posting initial metrics in 30m. Expect small p95 reduction for canary traffic if quant helps; quality check running against our 50-prompt eval set.

Maria (CSM): Perfect. Closing loop — I'll capture ClearParrot feedback after the enablement session and drop a short summary here so CS + Eng have a single record.

Lloyd (SRE): Noted. If anyone sees errors tagged `model-compat` escalate in #eng-runtime.

Eva (Product): If the compact-v2 path proves solid, I'd like to propose a follow-up: a scheduled optimization review in 2 weeks to discuss broader rollout and potential Dedicated sizing tweaks.

Maria (CSM): Agreed. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
